decisions.reason: This service fits the firm's core fibre and enterprise connectivity strengths and its move toward high-bandwidth software-defined infrastructure, so the option value remains attractive and continued visibility suggests enough promise to stay on the market.

A voice number ordering portal is a relatively low-cost extension that supports digital provisioning for existing enterprise voice services, so keeping it open is worthwhile while it complements the firm's broader platform strategy.

Carrier pre-selection is a legacy telephony offer with weakening strategic fit to the firm's shift toward integrated software-defined infrastructure, and its disappearance from the website soon after launch suggests the option's value was revealed as low.

This voice connection service appears to have shown limited traction after launch and offers less upside than newer data- and software-led services, so real-options logic favors abandoning it and reallocating resources.
